changeSet.author: enterprise
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE org_contract ADD COLUMN active_key BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (IF(status = 'ACTIVE', org_id, NULL)) STORED
ALTER TABLE org_contract ADD CONSTRAINT uk_org_contract_active UNIQUE (active_key)

changeSet.author: enterprise
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE org_payment_method ADD COLUMN default_key BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (IF(default_method AND status = 'ACTIVE', org_id, NULL)) STORED
ALTER TABLE org_payment_method ADD CONSTRAINT uk_org_payment_method_default UNIQUE (default_key)

changeSet.author: enterprise
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE org_subscription ADD COLUMN active_key BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (IF(status IN ('ACTIVE','PAST_DUE'), org_id, NULL)) STORED
ALTER TABLE org_subscription ADD CONSTRAINT uk_org_subscription_active UNIQUE (active_key)

changeSet.author: enterprise
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE consultant_license ADD COLUMN active_key BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (IF(status <> 'ENDED', consultant_id, NULL)) STORED
ALTER TABLE consultant_license ADD CONSTRAINT uk_consultant_license_active UNIQUE (active_key)

changeSet.author: enterprise
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE license_feature ADD COLUMN live_key VARCHAR(80) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (IF(live, CONCAT(license_id, ':', feature_key), NULL)) STORED
ALTER TABLE license_feature ADD CONSTRAINT uk_license_feature_live UNIQUE (live_key)
